title: Sadducees
summary: The Sadducees were a Jewish party connected with priestly and temple interests and known in the New Testament for denying resurrection.
background: They appear in disputes with Jesus and the apostles, especially around resurrection, temple authority, and public teaching about Christ.
teachingHelp: When teaching passages involving Sadducees, highlight how resurrection hope stands at the center of apostolic proclamation.
sources: International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, original 1915 edition.
